name: Z 轴顺序规则
description: SVG 渲染顺序（文档顺序决定 z-index），组合片段背景必须在激活条之前

rules.name: 组合片段背景先于激活条
rules.detect: function(eventType, payload) { return (eventType === 'review' || eventType === 'manual-review') && payload.error && payload.error.includes('alt'); }
rules.analyze: function(payload) { return { rootCause: 'alt 组合片段背景在激活条之后绘制，导致激活条被遮挡', impact: '激活条不可见，违反 §3.3.8.1', suggestedFix: '将 alt 片段 <rect> 移至激活条 <rect> 之前；同时改用 fill="none" 透明背景', severity: 'high' }; }

rules.name: 消息线在激活条之上
rules.detect: function(eventType, payload) { return eventType === 'review' && payload.error && payload.error.includes('消息线'); }
rules.analyze: function(payload) { return { rootCause: '消息线在激活条之下绘制，激活条覆盖了箭头', impact: '箭头不可见', suggestedFix: '将消息线定义移至激活条之后', severity: 'medium' }; }
